title: Source type11 fountain streams — host checkpoint
summary: Static source type11 fountains now produce separate ballistic streams with the original atlas, packet quantization and bounded one-draw rendering. All 40 original venue routes pass the latest host browser gate.
details: Two hundred original fountain birth cases execute 490,018 EE instructions and compare 44,460 raw words with zero differences. Together with the existing type0/type2/type8/timer gates, the source comparisons total 59,948 with zero differences. The ENV05 test-only source-attachment start shows center and directional fountain spray: desktop/portrait gates record 24,026/22,168 changed source pixels, a single draw, a 4,800-slot ring, and at most two contiguous updates per frame.

Pause and reset preserve simulation state; graphics restoration reproduces the retained GPU-buffer hash, including pending uploads after the last worker response. Motorcycle27 lifecycle gates also pass at desktop and portrait sizes (22,336/25,294 changed pixels). Fountain-only storage is 515,120 GPU bytes.
limitation: Host-only evidence. The screenshot uses a source-derived test start beside the fountain attachment, not an ordinary spawn or a physical-phone capture. Native shared manager/RNG ordering, camera-dependent fog overrides, moving attachments and complete VU/GS precision remain unverified. This does not claim public release, physical-device performance or PS2 hardware parity.
caption: Host Chromium 390×844 portrait: source fountain center jet and directional spray beside a test-only ATV start near the original attachment. Browser capture, not a physical-phone photo.
